title: List of Yoshi's locations
html:
This article needs Mario Kart improvement and is being worked on by Technetium (talk) and Maxed0ut2DMax (talk). Specifically:

  • Add descriptions of exact course locations.
Requested improvements must be clear, pertinent, and well-formed. Please refrain from adding bullet points such as "Add more information" or "Write the rest of the article".

The fast food chain Yoshi's has many locations spanning the map of Mario Kart World. This is a list of all locations and the Dash Food each serves.
